channel.title: Crisp Report — buyer guides
channel.description: Small-appliance buying intelligence. Headlines and dates only: this feed carries no store links, so the buying decision stays on a page where the disclosure is.

item.title: What to check on an appliance listing before you click buy
item.description: The fields that can be verified, the ones that are decoration, and the two lines that tell you a listing was written by someone who used the thing.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Nine cooking modes is a spec sheet, not a reason. Six questions that separate a replacement from a duplicate - and save you the counter space anyway.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The appliance you keep using is the one that is easy to wash and easy to park. Both are checkable before you buy, from documents you can open in a minute.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Litres, quart counts and 'feeds a family of' claims measure different things. Here is how to read each one without being sold something.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two shapes, two failure modes. The trade-offs that decide it are on the listing, if you know which fields to read.
